Flapple

Grass Dragon

Galar · Generation 8

Flapple is a Grass/Dragon-type Apple Wing Pokémon first found in Galar (Generation 8). It stands 0.3 m tall and weighs 1 kg. It evolves from Applin. Its highest base stat is Attack (110), with a base stat total of 485.
